document.abstract: This standard defines a standard for the authoring of declarative data content intended to be combined primarily with video and/or audio services, and distributed to data-capable television signal receivers. Declarative content is generally nonprocedural, and most commonly in the form of HTML. However, procedural scripting is also defined.
